body:
Track 2 follow-up to `ambient-goldaudit` (its first next step): for a budget B and a gold-audit price of 3, 10 or 30 noisy audits, how much goes to gold? Stylised, simulated results only.

Findings (from `experiments/results.txt`): all-noisy-read-as-truth is worst or near-worst in all 12 cells; 25% on gold with a joint EM fit is within 0.0009 of the best share in every cell, 50% within 0.0016; all-gold loses when gold is expensive. EM-start sensitivity in `experiments/start.txt` (at most 0.0009).

Checked: 5 tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok.
